capabilities: Start a Goodnotes handwriting session from the active note via an Apple Shortcut
Detect PDF, PNG, or JPEG exports arriving in the configured Inbox folder
File confirmed exports next to the source note's folder with versioned names and a metadata sidecar note
Insert an embed of the exported file into the source note at a tracked position
Reopen the original Goodnotes document from a saved share link and replace the stored artifact
extras: No network requests or telemetry; warns that Goodnotes share links are public to anyone with the URL; Apple Shortcut setup lives in docs/SHORTCUTS.md, not the README; interface follows Obsidian's language setting (Russian or English).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand off a note to Goodnotes for handwriting and file the resulting export next to the source note.

relations.evidence: It relies only on the standard Goodnotes export and share-link features
then runs an Apple Shortcut that opens Goodnotes

summary: Handwriting bridge that starts a Goodnotes session from a note and imports the exported PDF or image back with preview and confirmation.
